notes.title: Monster Taming Direct 2025 + Demo Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/96bae00ffa0fa50923846396b881a132fc1e7a3d.png"]

Version 1.2.2 of the Insectile Demo is here!



This update implements new animations to match the ones shown off in Monster Taming Direct 2025! If you have not seen the direct, I highly recommend you watch it here! (Thank you so much to Gym Leader Ed for selecting Insectile to be a part of the event!)


Animations
Taming now triggers a new animation where a jar clunks down over the target Insectile.

Morphing now triggers a new animation where the target Insectile wraps itself in silk.


Glitches
Fixed a glitch where a lily pad in the Muddy Poppy Patch would disappear.



Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any feedback on the demo!



I hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Insectile Placing Has Never Been Easier!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/494c50e4227b6d325027099357755c45e46e9eaa.gif

Patch Notes:

 Insectiles now have a dotted outline when placed.
 Insectiles now preview their effects when hovering above the board.
 Both of the above can be toggled on and off in the settings.
 Glitch fixed where NPCs may get stuck and soft lock the game.

notes.title: Demo This Friday!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/44d01a7ebd443beaecc4d1a8761dab1e6b8202a4.gif

We are just 3 days away from the Insectile Demo. The plan is to release it around 12:00 PM EST. Please tell your friends and leave a review when it comes out! I will place an announcement here when the release is successful.

Have a great day! See you all then!
- Narwhalnut
